newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil in talks over Caspian Sea field.
newsitem.headline: Statoil in talks over Caspian Sea field.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday it was in commercial talks with Azeri state oil company Socar on the further development of the Bahar field in the Caspian Sea.
The two companies have been collaborating for two years on technical studies of Bahar, which lies close to the Shakh Deniz area, Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said.

"While the northern end of the field has been onstream since the 1970s, primarily to supply Azerbaijan with gas, the unexplored southern section could contain substantial volumes of oil," Status Weekly said.
The talks will initially clarify the terms for a production-sharing agreement, with Statoil as operator in partnership with Socar. A deal could be finalised next year, Statoil said.
